description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and conversion of roof into habitable space with four roof windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Land quality - landfill gas monitoring/ ground gas protection measures (small developments)

EITHER

(a) No development shall take place until the site has been investigated for landfill gas in accordance with current UK guidance and best practice. Details of the monitoring results and any gas protection measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. 

Approved remediation measures, if applicable, shall be incorporated into the development and evidence of which shall be submitted to the local planning authority in writing for approval before the development is first occupied. 

Or

(b) The applicant may install gas protection measures incorporated into the development in accordance with a minimum of a Characteristic Situation 2 or equivalent specification before the development is first occupied. Photographic evidence of implementation and certification of Building Regulations inspection to demonstrate that the measures have been installed to comply with this specification shall be submitted to the local planning authority in writing for approval before the development is first brought into use.
Condition : 5 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
